current.name: Sherb
current.tagline: headbutts not optional, financially high-maintenance, still the best boy
current.bio: Sherb is a 7-to-8 year old orange boy and a former light-heavyweight street fighter. He enjoys never ending butt pats and cheek scratches, aggressive negotiations over canned food, and naps in the sun. He is looking for someone who understands that love is like a road trip — where you are always the driver, and he is the passenger princess demanding snack between naps.
traits: Purrs like a diesel engine if he even thinks you are going to pet him
Utilizes headbutts as a primitive form of communication
Absolutely under no circumstances will he ever miss a meal
The sweetest boy under a raggedy exterior
Despite the printer running out of ink he still displays orange cat behavior
redFlags: FIV+ positive, so other resident cats will need to be chill (see: adult)
Missing a lot of his teeth, so he requires a mixed diet of wet and dry food
Demands only the cleanest of litter boxes, and will let you know if you fail to meet his standards

archive.name: Waffles
archive.blurb: Waffles found his forever couch and has not moved since. Reports indicate he is thriving, mostly horizontally.

archive.name: Sir Reginald Pumpkinbottom
archive.blurb: Reginald now rules a household of two humans and a very patient golden retriever. Long may he reign.

archive.name: Noodle
archive.blurb: Noodle has successfully trained her new family to hand-deliver treats to the exact center of the bed.
